Next call is tomorrow so a response either way would be very useful; thanks. I don't think geth wants to run any validators context: geth team usually gets access to the EF devops validators/nodes and uses that on all testnets for whatever they need added a comment on our end Is it possible to commit to a smaller amount initially (say 5k) and then increase that to 100k a few months later? The reason is that at the moment Erigon lacks devops capacity. We've hired a devops who's starting in September, but it'll take him some time to get up to speed. Yeah of course, feel free to drop that in as a comment to let us plan around it super
